Если А, то достаточно ли ему пенни, или он вправе требовать косвенных убытков в виде добавочных денег, соответствующих возможной прибыли, которая могла бы проистечь от собаки и подлежит отнесению к заработанному приращению, то есть к узуфрукту?", "source_sha256": "ac79e14bedde15b185841092a585f0ebbf46d042f53b0a3a39b07f19f8bdd3bc", "target_id": "ru-ru77-u029-r0039", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "286cadfe9fac67c959763b69ce34c872e41ae72b91a3429c6707bf3f4362b40f"}, {"source_id": "ru77-u029-r0040", "target": "— Воистину, во всемудром и непостижимом промысле Божьем, Который неисповедимыми путями творит чудеса Свои, не слыхал я вопроса, равного сему по смятению ума и закупорке протоков мысли. Посему умоляю вас: пусть и пёс, и лук, и сии люди со странными и безбожными именами сами спасают свои души от своих жалких и дивных затруднений без моей помощи, ибо воистину и без того беда их довольно велика, меж тем как, коли я стану помогать, то лишь ещё более повредил бы их делу, да и, пожалуй, не дожил бы сам до того, чтобы узреть учинённое опустошение.", "source_sha256": "a0731b70494ffd0d317f917c4580aedfe6d80dca5a9b71762671362b0f29a80c", "target_id": "ru-ru77-u029-r0040", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "be3b052a7c4dba94a864d908d249999bd5b170aad0ed1e319817e47a2339a6ae"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru77-u029-r0041", "tag": "p", "text": "“What do you know of the laws of attraction and gravitation?”", "sha256": "bd5aad315720cbd07e3fc121e218adb5ca2dd752ee00cc5852b664b1750f4e4f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[41]", "source_html": "

“What do you know of the laws of attraction and gravitation?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0042", "tag": "p", "text": "“If there be such, mayhap his grace the king did promulgate them whilst that I lay sick about the beginning of the year and thereby failed to hear his proclamation.”", "sha256": "5e106cc34bbcc16ad4102ea619032724534cddf28ba18c1286f4acda648427f3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[42]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0043", "tag": "p", "text": "“What do you know of the science of optics?”", "sha256": "12829f663b86813c5556385d94cd92b511528d74e05efa6126d64dd6d1f86e44", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[43]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0044", "tag": "p", "text": "“I know of governors of places, and seneschals of castles, and sheriffs of counties, and many like small offices and titles of honor, but him you call the Science of Optics I have not heard of before; peradventure it is a new dignity.”", "sha256": "6cdd5bf0363eec05566c122ba59f961dcd7086ee364cb1da140226e2c00dbb3a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[44]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0046", "tag": "p", "text": "Try to conceive of this mollusk gravely applying for an official position, of any kind under the sun! Why, he had all the earmarks of a typewriter copyist, if you leave out the disposition to contribute uninvited emendations of your grammar and punctuation. It was unaccountable that he didn’t attempt a little help of that sort out of his majestic supply of incapacity for the job. But that didn’t prove that he hadn’t material in him for the disposition, it only proved that he wasn’t a typewriter copyist yet. After nagging him a little more, I let the professors loose on him and they turned him inside out, on the line of scientific war, and found him empty, of course. He knew somewhat about the warfare of the time—bushwhacking around for ogres, and bull-fights in the tournament ring, and such things—but otherwise he was empty and useless. Then we took the other young noble in hand, and he was the first one’s twin, for ignorance and incapacity. Try to conceive of this mollusk gravely applying for an official position, of any kind under the sun! Why, he had all the earmarks of a typewriter copyist, if you leave out the disposition to contribute uninvited emendations of your grammar and punctuation. It was unaccountable that he didn’t attempt a little help of that sort out of his majestic supply of incapacity for the job. But that didn’t prove that he hadn’t material in him for the disposition, it only proved that he wasn’t a typewriter copyist yet. After nagging him a little more, I let the professors loose on him and they turned him inside out, on the line of scientific war, and found him empty, of course. He knew somewhat about the warfare of the time—bushwhacking around for ogres, and bull-fights in the tournament ring, and such things—but otherwise he was empty and useless. Then we took the other young noble in hand, and he was the first one’s twin, for ignorance and incapacity. I delivered them into the hands of the chairman of the Board with the comfortable consciousness that their cake was dough. They were examined in the previous order of precedence.
